column1: # Written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later). Groups of first results that sources/measure.py puts in the class "linked
# word read as another headword": the matched text is one word ending in -ng whose spelling without -ng is a headword,
# and the first result is neither that word nor a term a row describes as a word with the linker. Every group of 10 or
# more positions in Tatoeba or in the two Gutenberg texts (final rules, untaggedTerms pass) is judged here by hand,
# from six random contexts each (measure.py tatoeba / text --show) and wty-tl-en's glosses; smaller groups are counted
# as not judged. "wrong" means the text means the word before -ng (or another word) and the first result is a

column4: ba + -ng (bang: a bang; an emphatic particle)
ano + -ng (anonang: a tree, through anong's form-of row)
kaya + -ng (kayan: an awning, through kayang's form-of row)
parang, like (Parang: a place), after a sentence end inside a Tatoeba entry
man + -g, even (mang: a term of address)
labing-, the -teen numerals (labing: a ravine, obsolete)
sala + -ng, fault (salang: putting a pot on the fire)
pala + -ng, the particle, in most contexts (palang: a bolo; pa lang)
tuyo + -ng, dry (tuyong: water added to a pot)
naging, the completive of maging (its own entry)
nagiging, the progressive of maging (its own entry)
kasing-, as ... as (sing-, the same prefix)
sayang, a pity, in most contexts
